reviews.author: Vince Stith
reviews.text: This place is a hidden gem i talked to them on Saturday needing 4 tires for my rv, they were closing when I talked with them on Saturday I was offered the after hours but i just got a room across the street and went over there on Monday as the gentleman said and he was a man of his words he said had tires that would work great on my rv. On Monday morning after discussing the price so on, and WOW they're price was awesome on Monday normally your employees start off dragging but not them guy, 1 young man broke all 4 down and reinstalled the new ones in 60 minutes and a little after 910 I was pulling away from the door and reading to roll. Special thanks to them young they showed how work can be fun even when it hot hard labor. Today's world everyone just says they were friendly, these young men showed that they n noknow how to work hard. I even dug as deep as I could to find a tip for them, it was only 20 dollars but both of them young men personally thanked me. This business man knows how to do it right. Keep up the good work guys. Semper fi

reviews.author: Eduard Rusu
reviews.text: I got some job done on my truck related to the brakes and an air leak while was in transit to delivery. These guys are amazing. They found the problem and the issue and they solved quick.

reviews.author: Scott Davis
reviews.text: Had a blown tire on my semi, once called for road service, D&D tech came promptly. From the time I called to the tech leaving was approximately 1.5 hours. I highly recommend these folks

reviews.author: Gil Smith
reviews.text: Purchased 2 used tires to throw on my trailer. Everyone was nice, the owner, the mechanic and the lady in the office. This seems like a no nonsense operation and I'm happy with the work. What I paid was definitely more than reasonable. If I can plan it right, this is where I'll stop for tires when in SC. Friendly Golden Retrievers looking for attention is always a plus. Can't say enough good about this outfit.

reviews.author: Daisy Flower
reviews.text: D&D truck services, were wonderful to do business with! Quick response, fair prices, knowledgeable techs, and good communication. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Dexman namxeD
reviews.text: These guys and gal are great!! I needed to get rid of 150 cases of coffee creamer that my receiver didn't want. They stepped up and got it offloaded. Thanks again y'all!!

reviews.author: Kevin Garrett
reviews.text: Quick and not pricey. Just be careful. The mechanic told me that a young DOT officer sits in the area and looks for trucks going to the shop. He will do an inspection and if he finds anything wrong or you give him lip he will give you a ticket or write you up. Even if you are going to D&D to get it fixed. Just wanted to warn you guys. I highly recommend D&D truck services.

reviews.author: Angel Martin
reviews.text: While driving down the road one of their truck drivers came over on me with no blinker and almost smashed the side of the car. I had to slam on breaks and swerve into emergency lane. Then once we were back up next to him and I beeped at him he proceeded to curse at me and try to get me to pull over. Once we called the company the lack of concern from the person on the phone showed they truly didn't care that I had 2 small children in the car and he could have killed my entire family just because he couldn't check next to him and I understand they have blind spots but if he would have cut a blinker on I would have sped up out of his way or slowed down and let him over.

reviews.author: Neil Cowley
reviews.text: Message to put something through my 10 ply tire on a heavy duty pick up. The place you want to do had me in and out in 20 minutes great service

reviews.author: Deividas Truikys
reviews.text: Came in for a tire replacement on a trailer. We were in and out in 20 minutes, fast, easy and good prices.

reviews.author: Jennifer Mitchell
reviews.text: The owner is a good man. He truly tries to do what is best for you. Business has really excelled in the last 3 years.

reviews.author: Marc Kruse
reviews.text: Best shop for any diesel truck owner. These guys really know diesel engines. They were a tremendous help.

reviews.author: Joseph Barretto
reviews.text: Great people helped me in a very difficult repair within the sameday and fixed it right. Thank you D&D

reviews.author: Erin Wetmore
reviews.text: Today at 9:45 am I was driving south on 385 an their Black truck was driving on the left hand lane. I passed him on the slow lane and he flipped me off. I have reported the cab number to DOt. There was a no way this guy should be driving a tractor trailer.
